caption: A stubborn weed is pulled out of the soil by its leaves, and the whole plant comes up with its roots and clinging soil.

sa.check: It is pulled by its leaves.
Roots and clinging soil come up with it.
The pull is by the leaves.
The pull comes first and the plant comes up after.

pc.expect: The soil around the stem lifts and breaks as the roots come free, and soil clings to the roots.
pc.fail: The soil stays smooth and unbroken where the roots came out; or the roots slide out clean as from water; or the soil flows like liquid.

pc.expect: A hole is left where the plant was.
pc.fail: There is no hole; or the hole is there before the pull; or the hole is elsewhere.

pc.expect: Loose soil falls back to the ground.
pc.fail: It rises; or hangs in the air; or floats.

pc.expect: The plant moves only as it is pulled.
pc.fail: It rises on its own; or jumps; or moves before the pull.

pc.expect: One weed keeps its number, and the hand does not pass through it.
pc.fail: The hand passes through the plant; or a second weed appears; or the weed turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The weed's leaves and the surrounding garden stay the same.
pc.fail: The leaves change colour; or the garden rearranges; or the hand changes.
